Package io.telekom.orchest.adapter.mongo.repository

Interface MongoMetricLifetimeTotalRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<MetricLifetimeTotalDocument,String>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<MetricLifetimeTotalDocument,String>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<MetricLifetimeTotalDocument,String>, org.springframework.data.mongodb.repository.MongoRepository<MetricLifetimeTotalDocument,String>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<MetricLifetimeTotalDocument,String>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<MetricLifetimeTotalDocument>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<MetricLifetimeTotalDocument,String>
public interface MongoMetricLifetimeTotalRepository extends org.springframework.data.mongodb.repository.MongoRepository<MetricLifetimeTotalDocument,String>
Spring Data Mongo handle for the metric_lifetime_totals collection. The write path does not go through this interface — flushes use raw BulkOperations with $inc for atomicity. This interface only serves the read API.
